title: Do you have anything backing your game beside "I prompt it with deeply care and attention"?
author: Free-Version-2746
selftext:
\-I am artist, but I have jobs so I just let AI do everything included art.

At worst, I will get my hand dirty, replace AI assets with my own.

Don't know much about marketing. But if thing too sour, I can also draw some hot tomboy, farm karma and drive some traffic to my game steam page.
